source: test fixture — issue #208 item 2: the contraindication rule shapes the injected record's NEGATIVE half may not claim
description: Four rules on one entry, three of them shapes that a curated file may carry and the module cannot simply call absent. (1) An allergy rule the patient matches. (2) A CONDITION rule carrying the very note of rule 1 — a natural way to author 'recorded either way', and the shape that would otherwise put one clause in both halves and make the record contradict itself. (3) A rule typed 'diagnosis', which is neither of the two chart lists this module reads, so it cannot be evaluated at all — JsonDrugReferenceSource validates neither type nor token, dropping an entry only for a blank id or name. (4) A condition rule with an EMPTY token, which the matcher can never match against anything. Rules 3 and 4 must be listed and claimed neither way: saying the chart does not record them would be issue #208's own failure with the sign flipped, asserted about a patient nobody checked.

contraindications.note: avoid in CKD stage 4 or worse
